title: State is not properly updated on L2, leading to stuck prize NFTs
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** High, as winning prize NFTs won't be claimable  **Likelihood:** High, as functionality is never working correctly  ## Description  The `addToParty` method in `HibernationDen` does not send a cross-chain message, even though it pushes sleepers into the `party.sleepoors` array on L1. Since the array won't be updated on L2, now all the calculations and validations that are done based on the `party.sleepoors.length` value will be incorrect.
